title: Youth Curfew, Cultural Center, Nuclear Plant Talks
summary:
*   Collaborated with the school district (AISD) on agreements for shared facility use, school security updates, and a potential city-wide youth curfew ordinance.
*   Briefed on progress toward establishing a Mexican-American Cultural Center and reviewed booking policies for the Convention Center.
*   Entered executive session to discuss significant litigation and ownership interests concerning the South Texas Nuclear Plant.
